title: Grateful Dead Live at Oregon Country Fair on 1982-08-28
lineage: Cassette  (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1982 show with a monster Other One, Althea and Black Peter, though the second‑set opener is a bit disjointed.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers crystal‑clear soundboard fidelity that lets listeners hear every nuance – from Brent’s black‑sabbath organ on The Other One to Jerry’s soaring leads. Musically the concert bursts with energy and features standout performances of The Other One, Althea, Black Peter and China Rider, even if the opening quartet of new songs in the second set feels weak and uneven.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars, praising both the superb soundboard quality and the high‑energy performance; only a few note setlist flaws, keeping the overall rating in the “good‑to‑great” range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the soundboard crisp, fantastic and immaculate; no major dropouts or distortion are reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set 1 sizzles, but Set 2 opens with four new, weak choices (Day Job, West LA, Far From Me) making the flow feel disjointed before hitting its stride with the strong second‑half material.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for all‑out extravaganza leads, high energy and occasional lyric improvisations; overall a standout guitarist on this night.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for “lots of Phil” and strong bass presence throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s organ work described as out‑of‑this‑world, bordering on Black Sabbath intensity, especially during The Other One; also praised for vocal contributions.
